pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint Paul Preaching at Athens - the apostle standing up on the step in the green tunic and the rose cloak with both hands lifted as he speaks, the Athenians seated below him on the pavement with their faces turned up to him and one boy standing at his shoulder, the great stone arch and the pillars rising above them, the double-minded I despise but Your law I love, You are my hiding place and my shield, I put my hope in Your word, depart from me you evildoers
pictures.name: pd_raphael_prediking

pictures.scene: Michael Ancher, The Sick Girl - the girl lying propped up on the blue pillows in her yellow bedjacket with the dark book held open on the white coverlet, the little posy of flowers and the medicine bottles standing on the red table at her side, the bare white wall filling the whole upper half, that I may obey the commandments of my God, sustain me as You promised that I may live, let me not be ashamed of my hope
pictures.name: pd_ancher_ziekbed

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, The Fog Warning - the lone fisherman in the dark oilskins pulling at the oars of his dory with the great halibut lying white in the bottom of the boat, the heavy swell lifting under the bow and the grey fog bank coming down across the pale sky, uphold me and I will be saved that I may always regard Your statutes, You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain
pictures.name: pd_homer_mistwaarschuwing

pictures.scene: Eero Jarnefelt, Under the Yoke - the heaped brushwood burning on the cleared hillside with the red flames and the smoke going straight up, the two women raking the branches into the fire and the man in the hat bent over his pole in the ash, the blue forest and the pale sky standing out behind them, all the wicked on earth You discard like dross, therefore I love Your testimonies, my flesh trembles in awe of You, I stand in fear of Your judgments
pictures.name: pd_jarnefelt_brandveld

lines.text: You are my hiding place and my shield;
I put my hope in Your word.
that I may obey the commandments of my God.
Sustain me as You promised, that I may live;
let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Uphold me, and I will be saved,
that I may always regard Your statutes.
You reject all who stray from Your statutes,
for their deceitfulness is in vain.
All the wicked on earth You discard like dross;
My flesh trembles in awe of You;
I stand in fear of Your judgments.
